title: 'Cheat Fuyo' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Asa Rokushima 's Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Reveals Main Trailer, New Visual, Cast, October 6 Premiere
content: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life anime revealed the main trailer and new visual, along with more cast and an October 6, 2026 premiere. The anime previously revealed an action trailer last month.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Reveals Its First Look At Fall 2026 Anime Schedule
content: Summer 2026 has been an exciting season for anime fans with the return of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War and Saga of Tanya the Evil . Along with the major sequels, the latest season also introduced fans to some major hits such as Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia and Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Anata o Korosu Tabi BL Series Gets 2nd Season
content: Fuji TV announced on Tuesday that it is producing a second season for the live-action series of Sai Asai 's Anata o Korosu Tabi (A Journey to Kill You) boys' love manga that will premiere on Fuji TV On Demand on October 8.
author: ANN

title: 'She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man' Manga to End in Volume 16
content: The publisher Micro Magazine and online retailers are listing the 16th volume of Dicca Suemitsu 's manga adaptation of Hirotsugu Ryusen 's She professed herself pupil of the wise man. ( Kenja no Deshi o Nanoru Kenja ) light novels as the final volume. The volume will ship on October 29.
author: ANN

title: Critically Acclaimed Shonen Jump Series Drops New Look At Time-Skip For a Major Event
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized hundreds of series over the decades, but only a handful of those have been able to etch their names in history. While Assassination Classroom isn’t a big-shot classic like the Shonen Big 3, it’s still one of the most beloved series of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: KADOKAWA to Merge ENGI and 4 Anime Studios Into New Studio One Base in November 2026
content: KADOKAWA will merge five of its anime production subsidiaries into a new company called Studio One Base, with the new studio scheduled to be established in November 2026. On the book side, the company also announced that it will be merging Dengeki Bunko and Dengeki no Shin Bungei into its main corporate website on…

title: Amasian TV Streams Hyakusho Kizoku-the farmer's days Seasons 2, 3 for Free
content: ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV confirmed on Tuesday that it is now streaming the second and third television anime seasons based on Hiromu Arakawa 's autobiographical manga Hyakushō Kizoku (The Peasant Noble) with English subtitles and Japanese audio in the United States.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Reveals Wild New Look At Beloved Characters For a Major Project
content: It’s been several years since the anime and manga both reached their conclusions, but Attack on Titan continues to rise in popularity. Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the series became a global phenomenon thanks to its unique story and layers of mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Already Has a Finale Date For Season 1
content: Summer 2026 was another major year for anime fans with several new introductions and sequels. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe, Crunchyroll releases dozens of new series every quarter.
